reason: I do want a rebrand, but a six-second reel from a studio I have never heard of, asking me to comment 11, does not tell me what the $800 actually gets me or whether they have done businesses like mine. I would take the free look to see what they say, but I would not hand over money on this.
objection: I cannot tell from the reel what I get for $800 or whether they have worked with a business like mine, and at about 2% of what I earn in a year, I do not want to guess.
would_change_my_mind: A short list of past clients in hospitality or real estate, with their before and after brands, and a clear list of what the $800 includes.
